messages.content: How long does a refund take after my return is received? (ref e831191f)

messages.content: Is there a fee if I return opened electronics? (ref 91aef9b3)

message.content: Yes, a 15% restocking fee applies to returns of opened electronics. Most other returns are free, but this fee is specifically charged for opened electronics and custom items.
